title: Day 694 — Sheinbaum Signs Overhaul of 38-Year-Old Environmental Law, Sends It to Congress
detail: On August 26, 2026 (Day 694, Wednesday), President Sheinbaum signed an initiative to overhaul the Ley General del Equilibrio Ecológico y la Protección al Ambiente (LGEEPA), Mexico's core environmental statute, unchanged in substance since 1988 (last major update 1995). Environment Secretary Alicia Bárcena presented the ten guiding principles at the mañanera, framing the bill around ecological justice: an earlier and broader Strategic Environmental Assessment requirement for large projects, a ban on splitting projects into smaller pieces to dodge regional review, new restoration programs for rivers, mangroves, coastlines and forests, financial compensation for communities that protect natural areas, and new protections for environmental defenders. The initiative — proposed under the title Ley General de Protección Ecológica y Justicia Ambiental — now goes to the Chamber of Deputies for debate.

media.caption: Sheinbaum signs the initiative overhauling Mexico's 38-year-old core environmental law

title: Day 694 — Sheinbaum Conditions Trump Meeting on Reaching a Deal, Still Weighing G20 Miami Trip
detail: On August 26, 2026 (Day 694, Wednesday), President Sheinbaum said a face-to-face meeting with U.S. President Trump would come once trade, tariff, security and migration talks produce results: "Cuando lleguemos a un acuerdo, ya podríamos reunirnos." She noted the two have spoken by phone 21 times and crossed paths at the World Cup, with negotiating teams continuing work in Washington. On a possible December G20 summit in Miami, she confirmed Trump had invited her and said Mexico should be represented, but attendance remained under evaluation, with a decision expected closer to the event; asked whether the summit could be used to resolve pending bilateral issues, she said only "Ya habrá oportunidad."

media.caption: Sheinbaum says a Trump meeting depends on reaching an agreement, weighs G20 Miami attendance
